sources.title: README.md · 6block/MiniMax-H3-Qwen3-VL-Abliterated-NVFP4 at main
sources.snippet: An abliterated, NVFP4 (4-bit) Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder for MiniMax-H3, made with convert-to-quant. It is a drop-in replacement for the H3 conditioning text encoder (ComfyUI CLIPLoader, type minimax).
